words.meaning: A feeling of fear, alarm, or nervous agitation about something that may happen
words.sentence1: She stepped onto the stage with a quiet sense of trepidation, unsure of how the audience would receive her performance. (She stepped onto the stage with a quiet sense of trepidation, unsure of how the audience would receive her performance.)
words.sentence2: Despite his lingering trepidation, he boarded the flight to begin his journey abroad. (Despite his lingering trepidation, he boarded the flight to begin his journey abroad.)

words.meaning: A deep feeling of anguish, heartache, or distressing sorrow
words.sentence1: Sintio una honda congoja al despedirse de su pueblo natal en el ultimo tren de la noche. (He felt deep heartache upon saying goodbye to his hometown on the last night train.)
words.sentence2: El abrazo calido de su hermana logro calmar la congoja que le oprimia el pecho. (His sister's warm hug managed to soothe the anguish oppressing his chest.)

words.meaning: An intense, glowing warmth of feeling, devotion, or enthusiasm
words.sentence1: Elle defendit ses idees avec une ferveur sincere qui toucha profondement l'auditoire. (She defended her ideas with a sincere fervor that deeply moved the audience.)
words.sentence2: La chorale chanta avec une telle ferveur que la cathedrale entiere sembla vibrer d'emotion. (The choir sang with such fervor that the entire cathedral seemed to vibrate with emotion.)

words.meaning: A profound feeling of reverent awe mixed with humility and deep respect
words.sentence1: Als er den uralten Wald betrat, erfullte ihn eine lautlose Ehrfurcht vor der Natur. (When he entered the ancient forest, a silent awe before nature filled him.)
words.sentence2: Sie blickte mit tiefer Ehrfurcht auf die jahrhundertealten Handschriften im Archiv. (She looked upon the centuries-old manuscripts in the archive with deep reverence.)

words.meaning: A bittersweet feeling of warm, fond nostalgia brought on by a cherished memory
words.sentence1: Furui arubamu o mekuru to, kokoro no oku kara natsukashisa ga komiagete kita. (Flipping through the old photo album, a warm nostalgia welled up from deep within my heart.)
words.sentence2: Furusato no umi no nioi wa, itsumo watashi ni yawarakana natsukashisa o hakonde kuremasu. (The scent of the sea from my hometown always brings me a gentle sense of nostalgia.)

words.meaning: The feeling of comfort and ease that comes after anxiety, pain, or trouble has lifted
words.sentence1: Un profondo sospiro di sollievo attraverso la stanza quando giunse la buona notizia. (A deep sigh of relief swept across the room when the good news arrived.)
words.sentence2: Trovo finalmente sollievo dalle sue preoccupazioni passeggiando lungo la riva tranquilla del lago. (He finally found relief from his worries by strolling along the tranquil shore of the lake.)

words.meaning: A disheartened emotional state characterized by a sense of loss, empty disappointment, or abandonment
words.sentence1: Kan dao kong dang dang de zhan tai, ta de xinzhong yong shang le yi gu nan yi yan yu de shiluo. (Seeing the empty train platform, an unspeakable feeling of loss welled up in her heart.)
words.sentence2: Jingli le shibai zhi hou, ta bu jin mei you chenni yu shiluo, fan'er gengjia jianqiang. (After experiencing failure, instead of wallowing in disappointment, he became even stronger.)

words.meaning: The emotional sensation of fear, dread, or apprehension regarding the unknown or dangerous
words.sentence1: Geuneun duryeoumeul igyeonaego eodun donggureul hyanghae cheot georeumeul naedideotta. (He overcame his fear and took his first step toward the dark cave.)
words.sentence2: Miju-ui saeroun sijageun duryeoumkkwa gidaegeumeul 동시에 angyeo jueotta. (Beginning something unknown brought both dread and anticipation at the same time.)

words.meaning: A state of anxiety, persistent worry, or restless mental agitation
words.sentence1: Khavol-khvay knong chet ban rolay tow pel ban luh somleng mday. (The anxiety in his heart melted away when he heard his mother's voice.)
words.sentence2: Neang mean seychakdei khavol-khvay champoh kar-siksa robos kone. (She felt a persistent worry regarding her child's education.)

words.meaning: The feeling of relief, alleviation, or unburdening after distress or tension
words.sentence1: Daar was 'n reuse verligting toe die dokter bevestig dat alles reg is. (There was an immense relief when the doctor confirmed that everything was fine.)
words.sentence2: Sy het met groot verligting haar rugsak neergesit na die strawwe bergklimtog. (She set down her backpack with great relief after the arduous mountain climb.)
